summary:
As a Software Engineer, I build products across frontend, backend, and automation with a focus on clarity, performance, and maintainability. My daily stack spans React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Rust, MongoDB, MySQL, and Docker, so I can move comfortably between interfaces, APIs, and systems.

Since Sep 2025, I have been working at Revel Healthtech in the healthcare domain, and over the last 7+ months I have been improving scheduling, manage visits, call logs, outreach, clinical team tools, search, navigation, and release quality. Across client work and public repositories, I have shipped 35+ products and 72 GitHub repositories covering healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, DeFi, tooling, and open-source experiments. I care about clean architecture, fast user experiences, and codebases that stay easy to extend.

experience.description: Since Sep 2025, I have been building healthcare product experiences at Revel Healthtech. Over 7+ months, I have focused on making clinical and operations workflows faster, clearer, and more reliable across scheduling, visits, call logs, outreach, search, and navigation.
achievements: Stabilized healthcare workflows across manage visits, scheduling, skip-appointment flows, call logs, outreach filters, and clinical-team screens.
Improved grid view behavior, search box UX, route flicker handling, and step navigation so care teams can move through the app with less friction.
Added automated test IDs and a pre-push hook to strengthen QA, catch regressions earlier, and make release validation more reliable.
Consolidated repeated bug fixes into shared flows to reduce duplication and keep the frontend easier to maintain across adjacent healthcare features.

highlights.title: Healthcare workflow reliability
details: Refined visit management, scheduling, outreach, and skip-appointment screens
Reduced friction in call log and clinical team workflows
Kept the UI predictable for care-coordination tasks

highlights.title: Release readiness and QA
details: Added automated test IDs to support stronger regression coverage
Introduced a pre-push hook for cleaner release validation
Grouped common bug fixes to avoid repeated implementation patterns

experience.description: At RecruiterFlow, I worked as a Frontend Developer, focusing on building reusable components and developing web applications with cutting-edge features. These applications were utilized by thousands of users in their daily routines.
achievements: Redesigned the application form, which is used by more than 1 million people every week. Implemented React similarly to how Meta does it, by injecting it inside the webpage instead of building the entire page with React. This solution significantly increased the speed of the website.
Implemented OpenAI and Bard APIs to automate text writing. Added the speech-to-action feature to enable users to perform actions using voice commands.

Worked on upgrading the Frontend libraries in our very large project with a lot of dependencies. Achieved 100% uptime and zero bugs in production by upgrading chunks of libraries at a time, starting with Node and React. Received praise from the CTO for this accomplishment.

Integrated RF-GPT into our SaaS product, which helps recruiters automate tasks such as email writing, job description creation, and call logs. This feature enhances their workflow by generating screening questions, saving them significant time and effort.

highlights.title: Test Infrastructure & Coverage Expansion (550+ Tests)
details: Took ownership of setting up and expanding the frontend testing ecosystem
Introduced TypeScript for better type safety and scalability
Integrated Jest and React Testing Library (RTL) for robust unit and integration testing
Wrote 550+ test cases, achieving high coverage across critical features

highlights.title: AG Grid Optimization & Bundle Chunking (~45% Faster Load Time)
details: Refactored large data-heavy modules using code-splitting and dynamic imports, significantly reducing initial load size
Optimized AG Grid rendering and state updates, resulting in a ~45% improvement in page load and render times for large datasets
Leveraged techniques like virtualization tuning, memoization, and selective column rendering to minimize unnecessary re-renders
Collaborated closely with the backend team to implement efficient pagination and data shaping strategies
